That is the test for the day view: is every everyday thing one tap away, beautiful and alive? Nothing less is the bar. And the vision behind the bar is the divine design: the internet itself feeling alive, like living intelligence — an ultimate interface, built justly and fairly for everyone, the creator working with all the Nayas and a human on earth to make it so. "Imagine it is being done right now — because it is. So let's make it so." That is the mission said as a vision: not a feature, not a round — the reason the whole thing is being built. This is a standing vision, not a round — it governs what the day view is for and what bar it is judged against.
